subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “But many liked reducing waste.”?
options: The owner said she started the idea because she once went to school hungry as a child.
One student said, "My phone is useful, but I do not want it to be my only way to rest."
Then their teacher said, "Food can be a good way to ask about culture, but we need to ask with respect."
The owner said the shop was not for everyone, but it showed another way to buy daily goods.
